options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name (via aria-labelledby).

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: options
options.description: { value, label, disabled?, description? } with unique string values (flat list).

options.name: value
options.description: Initial selected value; also the value restored by reset(). Unknown values select nothing.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name for the hidden input.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown while nothing is selected. Default: localized "Select an option".

options.name: required
options.description: No selection is invalid; sets aria-required and shows the required indicator.

options.name: disabled
options.description: aria-disabled, removed from the tab order, not submitted.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Focusable and submitted; the listbox does not open.

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ expand: IconRef; selected: IconRef; error: IconRef }>

options.name: renderOption
options.description: Custom option content (since 0.9.0); the label stays the accessible name. Nodes are released with releaseNode when dropped.

options.name: renderValue
options.description: Custom content for the selected value (since 0.9.0); the label stays the announced value.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

options.name: direction
options.description: Listbox alignment direction (applied when the listbox opens).

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; computed on every change.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Value differs from the initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic selection (no events); unknown values clear it; clears an external custom error.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options. A value whose option was removed is cleared.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show the listbox; the selected (or first enabled) option becomes active.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Hide the listbox without changing the value.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user selects a new value.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Close, restore the initial value, and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close, remove rendering, listeners, registration, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-change
events.detail: { value: string | null; option: SelectOption | null; validity: FieldValidity }

cssClasses.name: aui-select__combobox
cssClasses.description: Focusable combobox; control boundary and popup anchor.

cssClasses.name: aui-select__check
cssClasses.description: Check icon on the selected option.
